name: Puppy Love RPG: Legend of Saga Quest
source:
The land of Puppylovia has been struck by a curse of madness. The town of Ciabatta has fallen to ruins and monsters are running amok. The feline guardian Freyz Inghart knows that he must put this right, as that curse is his alone to bear.

[From [url=https://studioknockout.itch.io/puppy-love-rpg]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Puppylovia的土地受到了疯狂诅咒的袭击。恰巴塔镇已沦为废墟，怪物横行。猫科动物守护者弗雷兹·英哈特知道他必须纠正这个错误，因为这个诅咒只有他一个人承受。

[来自[url=https://studioknockout.itch.io/puppy-love-rpg]Itch.io[/url]]
